note: Hand data for tools/plate/split.py, Çağlayan's sky set (ADR-0025). Pixels are master pixels at x2 (2048 x 3072: the portrait master of x-caglayan-portrait-s4-day t1 at 1024 x 1536, upscaled, with the island of the picked stage plates pasted over it by tools/plate/portrait.py). One day master; every stage plate's island is cut over the same sky. The island matte is the landscape plates' committed matte-day-0.png, placed by `matteFrame`. The two distant isles' mattes (mattes/*.png) come from tools/plate/sprite_matte.py and may be adjusted by hand. `export` holds what the Home sets do not need: the picture runs past the master at the Island stop (the screen shows about 1.03 master widths and 1.5 master heights). `beam` is the chimney's smoke: it belongs to the island layer, which never drifts.

parallax.note: Home's constants; the sky gradient and the island stand still. Layers marked tile wrap in x.
